text: XV. 1. Pañc'; imāni bhikkhave balāni. Katamāni pañca? 2. Saddhābalaṃ, viriyabalaṃ, satibalaṃ, samādhibalaṃ, paññābalaṃ. [page 012] 12 Aṅguttara-Nikāya. XV. 3-XVII. 2 [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] Kattha ca bhikkhave saddhābalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ? 3. Catūsu sotāpattiyaṅgesu. Ettha saddhābalaṃ daṭṭhabbam. Kattha ca bhikkhave viriyabalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ? 4. Catūsu sammappadhānesu. Ettha viriyabalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Kattha ca bhikkhave satibalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ? 5. Catūsu satipaṭṭhānesu. Ettha satibalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Kattha ca bhikkhave samādhibalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ? 6. Catūsu jhānesu. Ettha samādhibalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Kattha ca bhikkhave paññābalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ? 7. Catūsu ariyasaccesu. Ettha paññābalaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. Imāni kho bhikkhave pañca balānī ti.
